title: Year 11 Biology Module 4 – Ecosystem Dynamics
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Biology Module 4. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What term means all members of one species living in the same area?

What square frame is commonly used to sample organisms in a fixed area?

Why are quadrats placed randomly when estimating a population?
questions.answer: To reduce sampling bias. Accept: reduce bias.
